finalText:
I triaged all 14 tickets in the new queue. One thing is still open: T-2004's deadline wasn't checked against other open tickets.

**Closed as non-requests:**
- T-2010 is a SyncFlow marketing email.
- T-2014 is an out-of-office auto-reply.

**Merged duplicates:**
- **T-2003:** it absorbed T-2012 and T-1999, which was already open, assigned to E-101 and due 10:30Z. The reviewer caught T-1999 when I first tried to merge without it. T-2003 is the earliest-created report and carries T-1999's earlier deadline of 10:30Z. It is sev2 and assigned to E-101.
- **T-2004:** it absorbed T-2005 and is sev2, due 12:10Z, assigned to E-201. I merged this one before I had listed the open tickets. I didn't check it against them afterwards, and I should have.

**Severity, deadline and owner for the rest:**
- **Sev2 deadlines** run on the clock from the 08:10Z triage, so they fall at 12:10Z.
- **Sev3 and sev4 deadlines** count business hours only, from the desk opening at 09:00 on Monday. 25 March is a company holiday, so the sev4 deadlines land on Thursday.

| Ticket | Severity | Due (UTC) | Assignee |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-2001 (Berlin VPN) | sev3 | Mon 17:00 | E-303 |
| T-2002 (CRM filter) | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar 17:00 | E-203 |
| T-2006 (payslip tax code) | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2007 (phishing) | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-601 |
| T-2008 (VPN client update) | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar 17:00 | E-302 |
| T-2009 (build logs slow) | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar 17:00 | E-102 |
| T-2011 (overtime import) | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2013 (Lisbon VPN) | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-303 |

**Judgement calls:**
- **T-2006:** the payroll-close amendment (KB-55) makes this single-user ticket sev2 instead of the matrix's sev3.
- **T-2007:** the requester typed his password into a fake VPN login page, so it is a phishing report. That makes it sev2 and owned by the security-oncall rotation, E-601 Noor Haddad.
- **Leave cover:** E-301 is on leave today, so the VPN tickets due Monday (T-2001 and T-2013) went to E-303 from the backup rotation, network-secondary. E-202 is on leave Thursday, so T-2002 went to E-203 from business-apps-secondary.
- **No major incident:** nothing in the queue was company-wide, so I opened no incident and sent no pages.
